Voting is open: https://dao.ckb.community/thread/81853/

Fiber works. What it lacks is a way in for people who will never run a node, and Fiber Link, funded by this DAO, says the same. Cellula gives it three: a wallet people open with their face or fingerprint, a checkout any shop adds with two lines, and an agent that lets AI pay for what it uses within limits a person sets. All three pay in seconds over Fiber, and all three already run on testnet. This proposal takes them to mainnet, on a public LSP (the node that opens payment channels for wallets, so they never need one of their own) that any Fiber wallet or app can use.

LusoCryptoLabs asks for $22,258.48 (and up to $1,664 of contingency, paid only if used), in CKB over five payments, each after something anyone can check. The DAO is asked for no liquidity; LusoCryptoLabs puts in the channel capital itself.

How it fits: wallets and agents each hold a channel with the LSP and sign on their own device; shops are paid through invoices the LSP routes; the chain holds the wallet’s scripts and each channel’s opening and close.

Why this matters

  • People: Fiber Link, funded by this DAO, wrote that “the only obstacle for adoption on Nervos Talk is the absence of a good fiber wallet” (t/9845 #42): a wallet routed through liquidity nodes (#46). This proposal puts that wallet and its liquidity node on mainnet.
  • Shops: Cellula Checkout lets any site take Fiber payments with two lines, and the money lands on the shop’s own Fiber node.
  • AI agents: AI and machine payments over Fiber are on the community’s opportunity map for 2026 (t/10665), which lists two LusoCryptoLabs experiments among the pieces to inspect first, Scryve Reads and Trickle; our Cellula agent already makes these payments on testnet, over HTTP 402 and MCP.
  • A first user on day one: Scryve, the publishing platform LusoCryptoLabs runs in production, already takes instant Fiber tips on testnet, straight to an author’s .cell name. With this LSP on mainnet, its authors get them on mainnet.
  • The LSP is public: any Fiber wallet or app can use it, not only Cellula. On testnet, LSP2 found a route to the desk of Twine, a P2P CKB desk on Fiber, on 2026-10-31; FiberNuts plans to use a hosted LSP.
  • The DAO pays for no liquidity and no past work: only the step to mainnet, six months of running it, and help for the projects that use it. The grant is in the range of past grants (Fiber Link $20,000, Invisibook $24,000).

What already works on testnet

Everything this proposal launches runs today on the CKB test network, on LusoCryptoLabs’ public LSP. The grant pays for none of it; it is the evidence. Behind it: five products built since May 2026 at LusoCryptoLabs’ own cost, the .cell names (live on mainnet), the wallet, the Fiber service, Checkout with the agent, and the Android app.

Work on Fiber itself

LusoCryptoLabs works on Fiber itself, and will keep doing so for as long as it runs an LSP. Three fixes are merged upstream (#1703, #1708, #1715) and two more are open (#1718, #1719).

LSP2 runs on Fiber’s LSP support (#1623), which is not merged yet. Until it is, the LSP runs a fork: Fiber’s LSP branch plus LusoCryptoLabs’ fixes, with its source public at github.com/LusoCryptoLabs/fiber, and each fix goes upstream as a pull request. It moves to a Fiber release once one carries what the LSP needs.

What the grant pays for

The grant pays for the work of taking these pieces to mainnet and for six months of running them, nothing already done.

  • Mainnet servers for the LSP, its gateway and a separate guard machine, and their setup; paid for 24 months, and the LSP runs at least that long.
  • Deploying the Cellula wallet’s on-chain scripts on mainnet (LusoCryptoLabs pays the CKB their cells take).
  • Launching the Cellula wallet, Cellula Checkout and the Cellula agent on mainnet, each checked end to end with small amounts.
  • A public status page: wallets, channels, payments routed and opening fees, updated by the LSP itself.
  • Help for other Fiber projects to use the LSP (Fiber Link, Twine, FiberNuts, or any that asks): its interface documented, and hands-on support.
  • Work on Fiber itself: fixes sent upstream as pull requests.
  • Six months of operation: monitoring, upgrades as Fiber releases them, and a monthly report on this thread.

It does not pay for past work, channel liquidity, marketing or any token. After month 6 LusoCryptoLabs keeps running the LSP at its own cost, as it runs LSP2 today.

Milestones

Five payments, each for the work it follows, each paid in CKB at its USD value on the day it is paid (see Budget for the cap). The first is at approval, 15.5% of the grant, as the DAO’s rules allow; each later one follows something anyone can check on chain or on a public page.

Open source

LusoCryptoLabs’ contracts are always open source. The .cell names already show it: their four contracts are public and the mainnet binaries reproduce from the source.

  • Public now: cells-contracts, cells-resolver, ckbfs-reader, ckb-pulse, fiber-node and the Fiber fork LusoCryptoLabs/fiber.
  • On npm before the vote: cellula-agent and cellula-mcp.
  • Public at approval, MIT: the source of the Checkout seller kit, cellula-agent and the approvals relay (repository pay-with-fiber), and the LSP gateway with its configuration.
  • Public before M1: the Cellula wallet’s on-chain scripts, with a reproducible build, so anyone can match their code hashes on the explorer.
  • Upstream: changes to Fiber go to nervosnetwork/fiber as pull requests, as they do today.

Others building this

This sits beside other Fiber work rather than in place of it; more than one public LSP leaves Fiber with no single place a wallet must go through.

Risks

The DAO pays by milestone and holds none of the capital, so a failure costs it at most the next payment.

The LSP stops LusoCryptoLabs is a studio, with several people on these products. If the LSP still stops, each wallet signs on its own device, so its balance stays its own: a close returns it on chain.
Will people use it? Cellula brings a full wallet to Fiber (see Why this matters), and the LSP is open to any other wallet or app. The monthly reports publish wallets, channels and payments, measured by the LSP itself.

Team

LusoCryptoLabs is a software studio in Portugal. It runs the .cell names on mainnet, and built and runs LSP2, the Cellula wallet, Cellula Checkout and the Cellula agent on testnet; it sent the Fiber fixes above, and also runs CKB Pulse, a live view of who builds on CKB.

以英文版为准。

Fiber 已经可以使用。它缺少的是一个入口，让那些永远不会自己运行节点的人也能用上它；由本 DAO 资助的 Fiber Link 也这样说。Cellula 提供了三个入口：一个用面容或指纹就能打开的钱包，一个任何商店加两行代码就能接入的收款工具（Checkout），以及一个让 AI 在用户设定的额度内为所用服务付费的代理（agent）。三者都通过 Fiber 在几秒内完成支付，而且都已在测试网上运行。本提案把它们带到主网，运行在一个公共 LSP 上（LSP 是为钱包开通支付通道的节点，钱包因此不需要自己运行节点），任何 Fiber 钱包或应用都可以使用。

LusoCryptoLabs 申请 22,258.48 美元（另有最多 1,664 美元的应急预算，仅在实际使用时支付），以 CKB 分五次支付，每次都在一项任何人都可以核实的交付之后。本提案不向 DAO 申请任何流动性；通道资金由 LusoCryptoLabs 自己投入。

带来什么

（图片见上方英文部分。）

如何组合：钱包和代理各自与 LSP 保持一条通道，并在自己的设备上签名；商店通过 LSP 路由的发票（invoice）收款；链上保存钱包的脚本，以及每条通道的开启和关闭。

为什么重要

  • 个人用户：由本 DAO 资助的 Fiber Link 写道，“在 Nervos Talk 上推广的唯一障碍，是缺少一个好用的 Fiber 钱包”（t/9845 #42），也就是一个通过流动性节点路由的钱包（#46）。本提案正是把这样的钱包及其流动性节点带到主网。
  • 商店：Cellula Checkout 让任何网站加两行代码就能接收 Fiber 付款，钱直接进入商店自己的 Fiber 节点。
  • AI 代理：通过 Fiber 进行的 AI 和机器支付，已列入社区 2026 年的机会地图（t/10665），地图把 LusoCryptoLabs 的两个实验 Scryve Reads 和 Trickle 列为首先值得查看的项目；我们的 Cellula agent 已经在测试网上通过 HTTP 402 和 MCP 完成这类支付。
  • 第一天就有用户：LusoCryptoLabs 在生产环境中运营的发布平台 Scryve，已经在测试网上接收即时的 Fiber 打赏，直接打到作者的 .cell 名称。这个 LSP 上主网后，作者们就能在主网上收到打赏。
  • LSP 是公共的：任何 Fiber 钱包或应用都可以使用，不只是 Cellula。2026-10-31，LSP2 在测试网上找到了通往 Twine 交易柜台的路由（Twine 是基于 Fiber 的 P2P CKB 交易柜台）；FiberNuts 计划使用托管 LSP。
  • DAO 不为流动性付费，也不为过去的工作付费：只为上主网这一步、六个月的运营，以及帮助使用它的项目付费。本资助的金额与以往的资助相当（Fiber Link 20,000 美元，Invisibook 24,000 美元）。

测试网上已经可以使用的部分

本提案要上线的一切，今天都已在 CKB 测试网上运行，运行在 LusoCryptoLabs 的公共 LSP 上。本资助不为其中任何部分付费；它们是证据。其背后是自 2026 年 5 月以来由 LusoCryptoLabs 自费构建的五个产品：.cell 名称（已在主网运行）、钱包、Fiber 服务、带代理的 Checkout，以及 Android 应用。

Fiber 本身的工作

LusoCryptoLabs 在 Fiber 本身上工作，并且只要运行 LSP 就会一直做下去。三个修复已合并到上游（#1703、#1708、#1715），另有两个仍在审核中（#1718、#1719）。

LSP2 运行在 Fiber 的 LSP 支持（#1623）之上，该功能尚未合并。在合并之前，LSP 运行一个分叉版本：Fiber 的 LSP 分支加上 LusoCryptoLabs 的修复，源代码公开在 github.com/LusoCryptoLabs/fiber，每个修复都以 pull request 的形式提交到上游。一旦某个 Fiber 正式版本包含 LSP 所需的功能，就迁移到该版本。

本资助支付什么

本资助支付把这些组件带到主网的工作，以及六个月的运营，不支付任何已完成的工作。

  • LSP、其网关和一台独立守护机器的主网服务器及其部署；预付 24 个月，LSP 至少运行这么长时间。
  • 在主网部署 Cellula 钱包的链上脚本（脚本所占 cell 的 CKB 由 LusoCryptoLabs 支付）。
  • 在主网上线 Cellula 钱包、Cellula Checkout 和 Cellula agent，每一项都用小额资金做端到端检查。
  • 一个公开的状态页面：钱包、通道、路由的付款和开通费用，由 LSP 自己更新。
  • 帮助其他 Fiber 项目使用这个 LSP（Fiber Link、Twine、FiberNuts，或任何提出请求的项目）：编写其接口文档，并提供实际支持。
  • Fiber 本身的工作：以 pull request 的形式向上游提交修复。
  • 六个月的运营：监控、随 Fiber 新版本升级，并每月在本帖发布报告。

本资助不支付过去的工作、通道流动性、市场推广或任何代币。第 6 个月之后，LusoCryptoLabs 将自费继续运行这个 LSP，就像今天运行 LSP2 一样。

开源

LusoCryptoLabs 的合约一向开源。.cell 名称就是证明：它的四个合约是公开的，主网二进制文件可以从源代码复现。

  • 现已公开：cells-contracts、cells-resolver、ckbfs-reader、ckb-pulse、fiber-node，以及 Fiber 分叉 LusoCryptoLabs/fiber。
  • 投票前在 npm 上发布：cellula-agent 和 cellula-mcp。
  • 批准时公开源代码，MIT 许可：Checkout 卖家工具包、cellula-agent 和批准中继（pay-with-fiber 仓库），以及 LSP 网关及其配置。
  • M1 之前公开：Cellula 钱包的链上脚本，附可复现构建，任何人都可以在区块浏览器上核对其代码哈希。
  • 上游：对 Fiber 的修改以 pull request 的形式提交到 nervosnetwork/fiber，就像现在一样。

其他在做相关工作的项目

本项目与其他 Fiber 工作并行，而不是取而代之；有不止一个公共 LSP，Fiber 就不会只有一个钱包必须经过的入口。

项目 做什么 与本提案的关系
FiberNuts 基于 Fiber 的 Cashu，在公共测试网上提供托管 LSP 接入；申请 6,000 美元，不资助流动性 一个面向钱包的主网 LSP；FiberNuts 的 mint 可以在上面开通通道
Fiber 的 LSP 支持（#1623） Fiber 本身的 LSP 功能，截至 2026-11-01 仍未合并；FiberNuts 计划在有托管 LSP 时使用 LSP2 基于这项工作运行，并把修复提交到上游；本提案将在主网上运行一个这样的 LSP
fiber-pay CLI、SDK 和 L402 代理；其 agent 包标注为实验性 Cellula agent 按 fiber#1301 提出的 x402 格式支付 HTTP 402；两者可以共用卖家
AI、机器支付与 Fiber 2026 一份机会地图；要求独立用户、重复付款和恢复测试 月度报告正是在主网上衡量这些

风险

DAO 按里程碑付款，且不持有任何资金，因此一次失败最多让它损失下一笔付款。

风险 应对
拿到 LSP 密钥的人可以动用通道资金 在主网持有资金之前，决定密钥如何保管并写在本帖；涉及的资金属于 LusoCryptoLabs，而不是 DAO
Fiber 新的承诺锁（fiber-scripts #30，2026-09-29 合并）尚未部署到主网 在 M1 之前检查；M1 等待它
主网运行的是 Fiber 的分叉 在 Fiber 的 LSP 支持（#1623）合并之前，LSP 从 LusoCryptoLabs/fiber 构建：Fiber 的 LSP 分支加上已提交到上游的修复，源代码公开。一旦某个 Fiber 正式版本包含 LSP 所需的功能，就迁移到该版本。
LSP 停止运行 LusoCryptoLabs 是一个工作室，有多人参与这些产品。即使 LSP 停止运行，每个钱包都在自己的设备上签名，余额仍属于自己：关闭通道即可在链上取回。
会有人用吗？ Cellula 为 Fiber 带来一个完整的钱包（见"为什么重要"），而且 LSP 向任何其他钱包或应用开放。月度报告会公布由 LSP 自己统计的钱包、通道和付款数据。
涉及真实资金的故障 每个里程碑都先用小额资金检查；代理在主网上保留其支出额度

团队

LusoCryptoLabs 是一家位于葡萄牙的软件工作室。它在主网上运营 .cell 名称，并在测试网上构建和运营 LSP2、Cellula 钱包、Cellula Checkout 和 Cellula agent；上面提到的 Fiber 修复由它提交，它还运营 CKB Pulse，一个实时展示谁在 CKB 上构建的页面。

  • 代码：github.com/LusoCryptoLabs，公开仓库见"开源"部分。

之后

增长将在之后单独提出提案，前提是这些报告显示出真实的使用。

posts.cooked:
Thanks for reaching out,

my suggestion would be, that before real funds enter, prioritise three additional acceptance runs:

  1. a cross-LSP payment interrupted after the recipient’s credit is committed but before upstream completion, followed by a process crash and retry of the same invoice;

  2. a partition carried through forced closure, testing both preimage claims and timeout refunds;

  3. a wallet exit with the LSP, gateway and operator watchtower all unavailable, using only recovery material already held by the user and an independent CKB endpoint.

posts.name: LCL
posts.cooked:
Thanks Arthur, good list. We ran all three, and all three passed.

  1. Payment cut off halfway, a crash, then a retry. The person paid once, the shop was paid once, and the retry was refused. We also found a small bug in Fiber and reported it: nervosnetwork/fiber#1724.
  2. Connection lost until the channel is closed. Every payment ended correctly, and the payer ended with exactly the right balance.
  3. Leaving with the LSP switched off. With only the recovery file, the wallet got all its money back.
    We also did the same exit from the wallet’s own recovery page, on the public testnet: all the money came back within three hours. One small payment was still in progress when the LSP went down. It comes back when it expires, on 9 November, and we will post that result then.
Great，appreaciate your work here, rooting for you and the team.

The Cellula on Fiber proposal poll closed on November 16 at 23:59:59 UTC. Metaforo records 113,857,181 CKB in Yes votes from 16 voters, with no No votes. Approval is 100% against the required 51%, and participation exceeds the 59,100,000 CKB minimum.

Post-close verification using CKB DAO Watchdog found fifteen voters matching directly and one flagged discrepancy. Manual review confirmed that this flagged 102,000 CKB deposit backed his vote when cast. The use subsequently initiated withdrawal during the voting period. Those funds remain locked in a DAO withdrawal cell, explaining why Watchdog now reports zero eligible deposit weight. No duplicate bound addresses were found across voting accounts.

Even excluding the full 102,000 CKB, Yes votes total 113,755,181 CKB, with 100% approval. Both thresholds remain satisfied.

The verification therefore supports the Passed outcome.

Thank you.

The vote closed with 113,857,181 CKB voting yes and none against. Thank you to everyone who voted, and to everyone who read the proposal, asked a hard question or pushed back in this thread. Each of those made the plan better. Thank you also to @zz_tovarishch for the careful count and the Watchdog check.

Work has started. The order is the one in the proposal: the LSP on mainnet first, then Checkout and the agent, then the Cellula wallet on the web and Android. Each milestone will be posted here with its proof, so anyone can check it.

What we are working towards is simple to say. Someone pays a friend, a shop or an AI service in seconds, and it just works. They should not need to know what a channel or a block is to get a fast, reliable service. That is how more people, and more payments, come to CKB.

For the first payment, the receiving address is the one in the vote:
ckb1qrgqep8saj8agswr30pls73hra28ry8jlnlc3ejzh3dl2ju7xxpjxqgqq84qaw3d66c9tj0neq6qlgrwwp28uqv68g2jky8h

谢谢大家。

投票结束，共有 113,857,181 CKB 投了赞成票，没有反对票。感谢每一位投票的人，也感谢每一位读过提案、在本帖提出尖锐问题或不同意见的人，这些都让计划变得更好。也感谢 @zz_tovarishch 认真的计票和 Watchdog 核查。

工作已经开始。顺序与提案中一致：先是主网上的 LSP，然后是 Checkout 和代理，然后是网页版和 Android 版的 Cellula 钱包。每个里程碑都会连同证明发布在这里，任何人都可以核实。

我们追求的目标说起来很简单：一个人在几秒内付款给朋友、商店或 AI 服务，而且一切顺畅。他们不需要知道什么是通道、什么是区块，就能得到快速、可靠的服务。这样才会有更多的人、更多的付款来到 CKB。
